answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 3935 Country: India Title: What is Islamic point of views about service in commercial Banks? Question: What is Islamic point of views about service in commercial Banks? Answer ID: 3935 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 435/404=L) It is unlawful to discharge such duties in a bank which involve interest in anyway. The Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) has cursed those who take interest, give interest, write interest or bear witness to it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
